traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Apodanthaceae: plants usually monoecious, rarely dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit berry; stamens 15 to 100; carpels 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
